summary: Wetour Robotics filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 1, 2026, announcing a development demonstration of its Orchestra system, which combines surface electromyography (sEMG) with first-person vision to capture human demonstration data for robot learning. The release describes technical features, including a model outputting 20 joint angles and a force-estimation pipeline under validation. No transaction, financial terms, or special-situations event is disclosed. The filing is routine product/technology news from a foreign private issuer, presenting no deal mechanics or strategic action.
